name: sol8-table-action
goal: Keep ExplorerTable action labels and their arrows on one line without breaking horizontal scrolling

evidence: Fresh 1c1d003216 screenshots show Open split over multiple lines in the functions table at desktop and tablet. The label and arrow must fit one link row.
The standard catalog checked scroll hints, rows and links but never the painted action line count. Its existing cases now inspect the actual label range and arrow bounds after capture.
